data.title: Connect Biopharma reports positive Phase 2 asthma results
data.description:
Connect Biopharma Holdings ( (CNTB) ) has shared an announcement.

On September 15, 2026, Connect Biopharma reported topline data from its global Phase 2 Seabreeze STAT asthma trial of rademikibart as an add-on therapy for acute exacerbations in adults and adolescents with type 2 inflammation. In the 160-patient randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study, a single 600mg subcutaneous dose of rademikibart delivered a statistically significant improvement in lung function at Day 7, with post-bronchodilator FEV1 increasing 250 mL versus 120 mL on placebo.

The company said rademikibart reduced treatment failure by about 66% over 28 days compared with placebo and halved emergency department or unscheduled visits, though the composite treatment failure endpoint did not achieve statistical significance due to lower-than-expected event rates. Rademikibart was generally well tolerated, with a safety profile comparable to placebo, and Connect signaled that the data provide a clear roadmap for Phase 3 development as it prepares to release Phase 2 COPD topline results later in September and advance discussions with U.S. regulators.
